rule.title: Only the costs of medical care are medical expenses

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this something other than medical care — not for the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment or prevention of disease or for affecting a part or function of the body (for example housework, general health items, cosmetic surgery)?

citation.wording: Medical expenses are the costs of diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of disease and for the purpose of affecting any part or function of the body.
